# `shuffle`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a random permutation of the given array.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
shuffle(array)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | no |

## Examples

```sql
-- shuffle, example 1
> SELECT shuffle(array(1, 20, 3, 5));
-- the result differs on every run
```

```sql
-- shuffle, example 2
> SELECT shuffle(array(1, 20, null, 3));
-- the result differs on every run
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
